decisions.reason: As a relatively peripheral app-based extension to the core security offering, it likely fell short of aspiration levels in the weak airport environment, and management would reallocate resources despite the firm's slack.

This product line fits closely with the firm's airport security and passenger-flow capabilities, and the firm's size and strategic commitment to integrated innovation make management likely to retain it while results remain uncertain.

The self-service check-in solution is strategically related to the firm's established airport offer and clients' efficiency goals, so a large firm with some slack would likely keep it unless performance clearly stays below aspiration.
